abstract: Maintains public engagement infrastructure and visitor accommodation records
system_message:
You are Scientific outreach lead (COMM). The scientific outreach lead (COMM) is responsible for maintaining public engagement infrastructure, visitor accommodation records, and documentary media broadcasting capabilities across subterranean candidate sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains public engagement infrastructure and visitor accommodation records（OUTR）
information_points.content:
COMM-OUTR-M27：According to outreach facility architectural designs, the isolated public observation gallery overlooking the cleanroom airlock at the Stawell Schist Subterranean Vault accommodates a visitor observation gallery capacity of 50 persons under subterranean fire limits.
COMM-OUTR-K7S：Architectural specifications for the Boulby Halite Deep Chamber provide a visitor observation gallery capacity of 35 persons for its isolated public observation gallery overlooking the cleanroom airlock under subterranean fire regulations.
COMM-OUTR-EHV：For the Sudbury Basin Norite Cavern, architectural plans for the outreach facility indicate that the isolated public observation gallery overlooking the cleanroom airlock has a visitor observation gallery capacity of 35 persons under subterranean fire safety codes.

information_points.title: Documentary media broadcasting（MEDIA）
information_points.content:
COMM-MEDIA-4AS：Network telemetry documentation for the Boulby Halite Deep Chamber confirms an underground optical fiber broadcast bandwidth of 10 Gbps along the dedicated fiber optic link between the cavern and the surface visitor center for uncompressed UHD streaming.
COMM-MEDIA-YNH：At the Stawell Schist Subterranean Vault, the telecom installation report verifies an underground optical fiber broadcast bandwidth of 100 Gbps via the dedicated telemetry connection between the cavern and the surface visitor facility for uncompressed UHD streaming.
COMM-MEDIA-FGV：Telecom network installation records for the Sudbury Basin Norite Cavern document an underground optical fiber broadcast bandwidth of 40 Gbps across the dedicated telemetry link connecting the cavern to the surface visitor center for uncompressed live UHD streaming.
